currentRoundInspection.scope: Main connected villa and baths conservation complex only: mapped apsidal room outline and open rectangular peristyle, 32 near-view columns, shallow dry courtyard fountain, pale infill above weathered stone ruins, grey standing-seam roofs, higher basilica/Great Hunt ranges, stepped western baths and red octagonal frigidarium roof with faceted skylight. Triclinium, Xystus rooms/court, entrance remains and two eastern latrines are separate required models. Figurative mosaics, temporary art, furniture, signage and surrounding archaeological park are not copied into this exterior model.
